title: metric-anchored-fallback-and-regional-warmup-hotfix
author: Evelyn Park
description: Context: Following a regional incident (INT-8721) we observed oscillating circuit states when downstream capacity dropped and then recovered rapidly; this caused repeated degrade->reopen cycles and user-visible latency spikes. This PR implements a metric-anchored fallback smoother and a probationary regional warmup token mechanism to reduce circuit flip churn and provide graceful rejoin behavior. Changes include: 1) A new smoothing layer in the SLO enforcer that anchors fallback decisions to an aggregate latency percentile window (p95 over a 2m rolling window) rather than instantaneous error counts; 2) A probationary warmup token bucket for a region that has recently reopened (configurable tokens grant limited throughput so capacity can be validated without triggering global fallbacks); 3) Persistent circuit state audit log entries to avoid lost transitions during leader failovers; 4) Observability additions (metrics and traces) to measure 'probation_token_usage', 'smoother_decision_index', and 'regional_warmup_success_rate'; 5) Backwards-compatible defaults so existing deployments see no behavior change unless the hotfix flag is enabled. Motivation: reduce noisy reopen cycles, improve SLO stability during transient capacity restores, and give operators a safe window to validate capacity before exposing full traffic. Related work: ENG-4921 (post-incident stabilization), ENG-5120 (regional probations design doc), incident INT-8721 notes. Rollout plan: feature-flagged on main; deploy to canary regions for 24h with telemetry thresholds; if stable, flip for production; fallback path retains previous circuit behavior. Hotfix urgency: high — this has already been applied to one affected customer in a fastpatch, but we want mainline code and tests. Non-breaking change: defaults disabled for existing clusters except where hotfix flag true.

release_notes: Hotfix: Reduce circuit reopen churn and provide safe regional rejoin window. Key points: metric-anchored smoothing for fallback decisions; probationary warmup tokens for reopened regions; persistent circuit transition audit logs; new telemetry metrics and recommended alert 'SLOFallbackHighTokenDrain'. Default-off; enable via 'regional_warmup.hotfix' feature flag if you observed noisy reopen cycles.
